business_summary: Zhejiang Bangjie Holding Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, weaving, and marketing of seamless apparel in China and internationally. The company offers underwear, suits, and casual wear products; sports and outdoor wear comprising beach wear, sportswear, outdoor travel wear, etc.; casual wear products, including family wear, pajamas, etc.; fashion products, such as youth and urban wear, etc.; and others. It also provides financial and mortgage loans; property management services; and operates and manages hospitals, as well as is involved in the manufacturing of new energy power generation equipment; sales of new energy power generation equipment; battery manufacturing and sales; sales of solar thermal power generation products; and provision of solar power generation technology services. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Bangjie Digital Knitting Share Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Yiwu, China.
